A '''cohort''' was a unit in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] consisting of 1000 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]]. One [[mentop]] was assigned to each cohort.
